# apple_subscription_introductory_offer (Resource)

Offers new subscribers in one territory a free trial or a discounted price for their first periods. A territory has one introductory offer per plan type. Only `end_date` can change; other changes replace the offer. Destroying the resource ends the offer. Import it with `<subscription_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_introductory_offer" "trial" {
  subscription_id   = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  territory         = "USA"
  offer_mode        = "FREE_TRIAL"
  duration          = "ONE_WEEK"
  number_of_periods = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (String) Length of each offer period: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS`, `ONE_YEAR`.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) Number of offer periods.
- `offer_mode` (String) Kind of offer: `FREE_TRIAL`, `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a discounted price each period) or `PAY_UP_FRONT` (one discounted price for all periods).
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.
- `territory` (String) Territory of the offer, e.g. `USA`.

### Optional

- `end_date` (String) Last day of the offer. Unset means no end.
- `plan_type` (String) Plan the offer is for: `UPFRONT` for the whole period at once, `MONTHLY` for a yearly plan billed monthly. Defaults to `UPFRONT`.
- `price_point_id` (String) Price point of a paid offer, in the territory; see `data.apple_subscription_price_points`. A free trial has none.
- `start_date` (String) First day of the offer, e.g. `2026-12-01`. Unset means now.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_introductory_offer.trial
  identity = {
    subscription_id = "6446452616"
    id              = "9876543210"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_introductory_offer.trial 6446452616/9876543210
```
